bullets.text: Autonomous Container Transport Trial - The Port of Tyne advances towards autonomous operations with a successful self-driving vehicle trial.
VMO2's Renewable Energy Push - Virgin Media O2 secures a 10-year deal for solar energy to meet 5% of its demands.
New Subsea Cable AUÐUR - Iceland's Farice plans a new cable to enhance connectivity between Iceland and Scotland.
Bangladesh Telecoms Crisis - Fuel shortages threaten telecom services as operators warn of potential shutdowns.
Sustainable Design in Telecoms - Emphasizing durability can significantly reduce costs and waste in broadband networks.
Deutsche Telekom Merger Talks - Deutsche Telekom considers merging with T-Mobile to create a $267 billion entity.
